in_marathi.name: Dharmilan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmilan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharmilan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Dharma' meaning righteousness and 'Ilan' meaning protector or supporter. This name is rooted in Hindu mythology and is often given to boys as a symbol of being a righteous protector or upholder of values.
